parameters.jsCode:
const payload = {
  alert_type: 'test',
  regime: 'TEST_BCB_DIRECT',
  level: 'VERMELHO',
  levelLabel: 'VERMELHO',
  score: 1,
  title: 'BCB Direct Macro Smoke Test',
  tendency: 'teste controlado da camada macro BCB',
  conviction: 'baixa',
  win_read: 'Smoke test: confirmacao apenas de entrega, sem leitura real.',
  dollar_read: 'Smoke test: confirmacao apenas de entrega, sem leitura real.',
  us_read: 'Smoke test: confirmacao apenas de entrega, sem leitura real.',
  reason: 'Teste manual para validar Telegram, Discord e dashboard.',
  source: 'manual-smoke-test',
  channels: ['telegram', 'discord', 'dashboard'],
  quoteLines: ['PTAX USD: mock', 'Selic 2026: mock', 'IPCA 2026: mock', 'Cambio 2026: mock'].join('\n')
};
payload.discordText = `**BCB DIRECT | TESTE**\n\n**Titulo:** ${payload.title}\n**Tendencia:** ${payload.tendency}\n**Conviccao:** ${payload.conviction}\n\n**WIN:** ${payload.win_read}\n**Dolar:** ${payload.dollar_read}\n**Nasdaq/ES:** ${payload.us_read}\n\n**Leituras:**\n${payload.quoteLines}\n\n**Motivo:** ${payload.reason}`;
return [{ json: payload }];

parameters.url: ={{ (() => { const now = new Date(); const end = new Date(now); const day = end.getDay(); if (day === 0) end.setDate(end.getDate() - 2); else if (day === 6) end.setDate(end.getDate() - 1); const start = new Date(end); start.setDate(start.getDate() - 7); const fmt = d => `${String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}-${d.getFullYear()}`; return `https://olinda.bcb.gov.br/olinda/servico/PTAX/versao/v1/odata/CotacaoMoedaPeriodo(moeda=@moeda,dataInicial=@dataInicial,dataFinalCotacao=@dataFinalCotacao)?@moeda='USD'&@dataInicial='${fmt(start)}'&@dataFinalCotacao='${fmt(end)}'&$format=json`; })() }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { alert_type: $json.alert_type, level: $json.level, regime: $json.regime, score: $json.score, title: $json.title, source: $json.source, tendency: $json.tendency, conviction: $json.conviction, win_read: $json.win_read, dollar_read: $json.dollar_read, us_read: $json.us_read, reason: $json.reason, channels: $json.channels } }}
